summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload unrelated to package purpose
details: @servicetitan/dte-pdf-editor 1.76.6 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-bundled CJS module using string-array-rotation obfuscation (a rotator that push/shifts a large mixed literal array, plus a decoder driven by a permuted alphabet). The file is not declared in package.json "files" (which lists only "dist" and "src") and its name and content are unrelated to the package's advertised React PDF-editor purpose. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node evades Node-focused runtime scanning, and the obfuscated bytes' behavior is not verifiable from the shipped artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
